authentication.local: bearerTokenClaims: jose + JWKS do Google (RS256, iss https://accounts.google.com | accounts.google.com, aud GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, exp)
authentication.authorization: principalFromClaims: ownerId = sub; ALLOWED_SUBS fora do Git; vazio nega todos

localRun.api: npm run dev:api (127.0.0.1:4000; exige DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT em loopback)
localRun.db: npm run dev:db (amazon/dynamodb-local:3.3.1, volume miupy-dynamodb) + npm run db:create-table

moduleConvention.externalImport: Somente o index.ts público de outro módulo.
moduleConvention.composition: module.ts cria repository, service, controller e router; index.ts exporta contrato de service e factory.

modules.httpContract: apps/api/src/modules/notes/contract.ts (schemas Zod de saída; importado pelo cliente web; só depende de zod)

persistence.table: NOTES_TABLE_NAME (local: miupy-notes-local no DynamoDB Local; AWS: não criada)
persistence.list: Query pk + begins_with(sk, NOTE#); cursor opaco com o último id
